completionRule: A task is complete only when its acceptance criteria pass and its implementation is durably pushed or attached to the repository.

artRecoveryStatus.lostCheckpoint: Previously reported Alpha 3 / full art pass
artRecoveryStatus.legacyOverheadFiles: reference-only; excluded from runtime production art and completion
artRecoveryStatus.authorizationScope: Standing authorization to generate, review, document, commit, and publicly publish small reversible production-art checkpoints without repeated permission requests.

acceptance: Clean clone passes npm run verify
